Build me a sparse, sun-bleached desert settlement in a broad sandy basin, surrounded by low rolling dunes, pale rocky hills, and scattered monumental boulders. Center the scene on a paved four-way intersection, with gently curving roads extending outward through the landscape, edged intermittently by guardrails, utility poles, and overhead wires. Arrange roughly seven low, simple buildings around the crossroads: several long rectangular, dark-roofed residential or barracks-like blocks grouped loosely on one side, and a few smaller flat-roofed service buildings on the other, all separated by sandy yards rather than packed together. Beside the intersection, create an irregular cluttered roadside market or camp of small stalls, awnings, containers, and colorful canopies, with an oval dirt track looping around a rocky, palm-filled island nearby. Scatter dense pockets of palms, cacti, dry grasses, scrub, and stones among otherwise open sand. Add tall lattice communication towers near the buildings, major steel transmission pylons and power lines crossing the outskirts, and rows of wind turbines along distant ridges. Keep the layout organic, isolated, weathered, and quiet under harsh bright sunlight and a hazy blue sky.
